{{Top|leg}}
The '''Middle Generation''' was a term used on the planet [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] to describe people who were in their middle age. During the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]] almost the entire middle generation of Melida/Daan was wiped out. The remains of the Middle Generation later sided with [[the Young]] at the end of the [[Young–Elders War|subsequent war]].
